title: Acids and bases: names and formulas

cards.front: What is the name of the substance with formula $H_2SO_4$? For HCl or a hydroxide, also name its aqueous solution.
What is the substance formula of sulfuric acid?
cards.back: $H_2SO_4$. The formula identifies the substance, not the entire aqueous solution; it does not imply undissociated molecules in solution.

cards.front: What is the name of the substance with formula $HCl$? For HCl or a hydroxide, also name its aqueous solution.
